name: qwen3.8-27b-dflash2-w4a16-drafter
notes: DFlash2 block-diffusion draft model for Qwen3.8-27B, requantized W4A16 by syv-ai (the club-3090 ULTRAFAST/SUPERMAX drafter). NOT a served model — transfer profile only, used to mirror the drafter to R2 for speculative decoding (--speculative-config method=dflash). ~1.28 GB single safetensors (vs the bf16 incoai drafter's ~3.9 GB) — ~2.7 GB less read/step. Shares the target's embeddings/lm_head; target lm_head must be bf16. Pairs with the vllm#52816 DFlash2 backport on vLLM v0.27.1.
